tokens.note: Raw token counts. thinking_tokens is part of output_tokens and is never added on top. Context is input plus cache read plus both cache writes.

cost.label: Estimated list-price USD, priced per model from the stamped price table. The project is on a Max subscription, so this is a plan-usage proxy, not a bill (D-TP1).

context.note: Context pressure: how much each request re-read. These are token counts, not cost; the cost of carrying context is already inside the cost layer.

tools.note: Context exposure = result characters x requests that re-read them. A ranking of what fills context, not a cost.

prs.label: Estimated list-price USD, priced per model from the stamped price table. The project is on a Max subscription, so this is a plan-usage proxy, not a bill (D-TP1).

cache_policy.note: Cache read and write USD per agent type, replayed under 5m and 1h TTLs over the observed idle gaps. calibration = replay under the observed TTL / observed cache USD (1.0 is exact). Estimated list price, a plan-usage proxy.
